item.title: Self-Hosted GRE Tunnel Management — Open vSwitch vs Linux GRE vs GRETAP (2026)
item.description: Generic Routing Encapsulation (GRE) is a tunneling protocol that encapsulates one network layer protocol inside another, creating virtual point-to-point links between routers. GRE tunnels are widely used for connecting separated network segments, building overlay networks, transporting multicast traffic, and extending layer 2 domains across layer 3 infrastructure.
